<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 127.099714, which matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the formula C₇H₁₃NO (C = 84.0000, H = 13 × 1.007825 = 13.101725, N = 14.003074, O = 15.994915; total = 127.099714). The subsequent peaks correspond to the expected isotopic pattern (¹³C, etc.). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C7H13NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H13NO</final_answer>
